As Caterpillar (CAT) Share Value Declined, Holder Afam Capital Cut Its Stake; Apple (AAPL) Holder Overbrook Management Has Lowered Position
June 25, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Overbrook Management Corp decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 17.83% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Overbrook Management Corp sold 9,659 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 44,501 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.47M, down from 54,160 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Overbrook Management Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $903.89 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.55% or $1.02 during the last trading session, reaching $183.9. About 7.09M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
